name: rotation-merger
description: Implement missing features into EaxRotations - sticky spells, PvP mode, buff tracking, talent awareness

lead.prompt:
Lead the implementation of missing features into EaxRotations. Use the gap analysis in C:
ewbot\scripts\EaxRotations\GAP_ANALYSIS.md. Coordinate 4 implementers: (1) Infrastructure - add sticky spell system and proactive buff refresh to core, (2) PvP - add PvP mode to Warrior/Warlock/Hunter, (3) PvP - add PvP mode to Rogue/Priest/Paladin, (4) Talent awareness - add talent detection and spec-specific mechanics. Use ONLY api modules from C:
ewbot\scripts\api\ (spell_helper.lua, cooldown_tracker.lua, buff_manager.lua) and their docs in C:
ewbot\scripts\apidocs\.

members.name: infrastructure-impl
members.prompt:
Implement core infrastructure for EaxRotations. (1) Add sticky spell system to prevent double-casting - track lastCastSpell with timestamp and priority. (2) Add proactive buff refresh function that checks expiring buffs before combat. Read GAP_ANALYSIS.md. Use API: C:
ewbot\scripts\api\common\utility\spell_helper.lua, C:
ewbot\scripts\api\common\modules uff_manager.lua and docs in C:
ewbot\scripts\apidocs\.

members.name: pvp-impl-1
members.prompt: Add PvP mode to Warrior and Warlock specs. For Warrior: add stance dancing, intercept, disarm, spell reflection, interrupts (Pummel). For Warlock: add fear, curse management, pet control. Use API: C:\newbot\scripts\api\common\utility\cooldown_tracker.lua, C:\newbot\scripts\api\common\modules\buff_manager.lua and docs in apidocs\.

members.name: pvp-impl-2
members.prompt: Add PvP mode to Hunter, Rogue, Priest specs. For Hunter: add pet stuns (Intimidation), trap handling, aspect switching. For Rogue: add crowd control (Blind, Sap), interrupt (Kick), evasion. For Priest: add dispels, fear ward, shield. Use API: C:\newbot\scripts\api\common\utility\cooldown_tracker.lua, C:\newbot\scripts\api\common\modules\buff_manager.lua and docs in apidocs\.

members.name: talent-aware-impl
members.prompt: Add talent-aware rotation mechanics. (1) For Warrior: add HasMortalStrike(), HasSweepingStrikes(), HasImprovedSlam() checks to change rotation. (2) For Warlock: add HasConflagrate(), HasShadowburn() for different priority. (3) For Hunter: add HasBestialWrath(), HasIntimidation(). Use C:\newbot\scripts\api\common\talents_id.lua or implement via buff detection.
